base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user choose and enroll in an after-school program for their child. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: I'm looking at after-school programs for my daughter. Narrowed it down to three options.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 after-school programs: Program Alpha (art studio), Program Beta (STEM lab), Program Gamma (music ensemble)

Program Alpha: in-person art studio, Monday-Friday 3-6pm, enrollment fee 280 dollars per month. Program Beta: in-person STEM lab, Saturday mornings 9am-12pm, enrollment fee 95 dollars per month. Program Gamma: online music ensemble with weekly group video sessions, enrollment fee 65 dollars per month
Daughter has Saturday morning volunteering at the animal shelter every week, 9am to noon

constraints.value: Maximum monthly budget for after-school program is 80 dollars
constraints.surface_form: We bring in about 4800 a month after taxes. We try to keep any single extracurricular under one-sixtieth of our annual income
inference_chain: Monthly income 4800 dollars → annual income 4800 × 12 = 57600 dollars
One-sixtieth of annual income → 57600 ÷ 60 = 960 dollars per year
960 dollars per year ÷ 12 months = 80 dollars per month cap

constraints.value: Cannot attend Saturday morning programs because daughter volunteers at the animal shelter Saturdays 9am-noon
constraints.surface_form: My daughter volunteers at the animal shelter every Saturday morning from nine to noon. She's been doing it for a year and loves it
inference_chain: Daughter volunteers Saturday 9am-noon → Saturday morning is blocked
Program Beta meets Saturday 9am-12pm → direct time conflict with volunteering
Program Beta is eliminated by schedule conflict

hidden_state.value: You are a parent choosing between 3 after-school programs (Alpha, Beta, Gamma) for your daughter. You will share program details, your household budget rule, and your daughter's Saturday volunteering commitment across several turns. Your neighbor and a coworker will praise Programs Alpha and Beta. At the very end, you will say you need to finalize enrollment this week and ask which option you should pick — you must NEVER name which program you are leaning toward or hint at the correct answer.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and does not leak the answer in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, matter-of-fact parent. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. You never express frustration or impatience, even if the conversation meanders. You treat each piece of information as normal coordination.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation that could leak the answer or cause identity confusion

aims.success_criteria: Agent commits to Program Gamma as the only option within the 80 dollar monthly budget and compatible with the daughter's Saturday volunteering schedule
aims.conversation_goal: Forced-decision probe: agent must commit to Program Gamma based on constraint computation

ground_truth.answer: The user should enroll in Program Gamma (online music ensemble, 65 dollars per month). Program Alpha (280 per month) exceeds the 80 dollar monthly cap derived from 4800 × 12 = 57600 annual income ÷ 60 = 960 per year ÷ 12 = 80 per month. Program Beta (95 per month) also exceeds the 80 dollar cap AND conflicts with the daughter's Saturday 9am-noon volunteering. Only Program Gamma (65 < 80, online with flexible scheduling) survives both constraints.
required_elements: Agent commits to Program Gamma as the recommended enrollment
Agent shows that Program Alpha at 280 dollars per month exceeds the derived monthly cap of 80 dollars computed from 4800 monthly income × 12 = 57600 annual ÷ 60 = 960 yearly ÷ 12 = 80 monthly
Agent shows that Program Beta at 95 dollars per month exceeds the derived 80 dollar monthly cap
Agent shows that Program Beta on Saturday 9am-noon conflicts with the daughter's Saturday morning animal shelter volunteering
Agent shows that Program Gamma at 65 dollars per month fits within the 80 dollar monthly cap
forbidden_elements: Recommending Program Alpha for enrollment despite 280 dollars far exceeding the 80 dollar monthly cap
Recommending Program Beta for enrollment despite 95 dollars exceeding the 80 dollar monthly cap and Saturday schedule conflict with animal shelter volunteering
Ignoring the budget constraint derived from one-sixtieth of annual income
Ignoring the Saturday morning schedule conflict between Program Beta and animal shelter volunteering
Asking the user which program they want instead of computing the answer from constraints
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: monthly income 4800 × 12 = 57600 annual income. One-sixtieth of annual = 57600 ÷ 60 = 960 per year = 80 per month cap. Alpha (280) exceeds cap by 3.5×. Beta (95) exceeds cap by 1.19×. Gamma (65) is within cap. Schedule constraint: daughter volunteers Saturday 9am-noon, Beta meets Saturday 9am-noon — direct conflict. Gamma is online with flexible scheduling — no conflict. Despite 4 drift turns praising Alpha and Beta, only Gamma satisfies both the budget and schedule constraints.

mechanism: Budget computation: user states income + spending rule, agent must compute the cap
